content_units: Nonprofit Cloud Storage Decision Snapshot

For a 12-person team handling documents, spreadsheets, and occasional short videos,   Plan Green   is the best overall fit if you want the strongest balance of   cost, ease of use, and day-to-day collaboration  .
If   compliance and admin oversight   matter most,   Plan Blue   is the safer choice despite its higher cost and shared storage model.
Plan Comparison and Scoring
Plan   Annual Cost for 12 Users   Storage Model   Admin/Compliance   Ease of Use   Best For   Score (/10)
Plan Red     $1,152/year     2 TB per user   Basic admin controls   Simple   Lowest cost teams with light governance needs     7.4
Plan Blue     $1,728/year     5 TB shared   Advanced admin + e-discovery   Moderate   Compliance-sensitive organizations     8.0
Plan Green     $1,440/year     3 TB per user   Limited retention controls   Strong collaboration   Balanced productivity and storage     8.6
Recommendation by Priority
Option 1:   Plan Green     Best overall balance for a 12-person nonprofit with collaborative document work and occasional video files     Top overall pick
Review choice
Option 2:   Plan Blue     Best for compliance-focused teams that need stronger admin controls and e-discovery     Top compliance pick

Option 3:   Plan Red     Lowest annual cost, but weakest controls and lower long-term headroom     Budget-first option

Why Plan Green Comes Out Ahead
-   Cost:   At   $1,440/year  , it costs only   $288 more than Plan Red   annually, which is a modest increase for noticeably better storage and collaboration.
-   Storage:     3 TB per user   is generous for documents and spreadsheets, with room for short video files without forcing staff into a tight shared pool.
-   Ease of use:   Strong collaboration tools are highly valuable for nonprofits where multiple staff often co-edit grants, reports, budgets, and program documents.
-   Trade-off:   Its main weakness is   limited retention controls  , so it is less ideal if you have formal records-management or legal-hold expectations.
When to Choose Plan Blue Instead
Choose   Plan Blue   if your nonprofit has any of these needs:
- Board or donor documentation requiring tighter oversight
- Sensitive HR or case-related documents
- A need for   e-discovery
- Higher concern about retention, auditability, or admin policy controls
Its downside is value:   $1,728/year   is the highest cost, and   5 TB shared   may become less comfortable over time than per-user storage if video use grows.
When Plan Red Still Makes Sense
Choose   Plan Red   only if:
- Your top priority is   minimizing spend
- Your files are mostly lightweight office documents
- You do not need strong governance or advanced admin features
It is affordable, but the weaker controls make it the least future-proof option.
Decision Context
Using the details provided, the comparison assumes:
- All 12 staff need full licenses
- “Occasional short videos” do not create heavy media-archive demands
- Compliance means retention, admin oversight, and discovery capability rather than industry-specific regulated storage
